insights.bmiHelpBody2: It is a rough screening number. It does not know your muscle mass, age or build, so use it alongside advice from a professional.

verdictColors.title: Verdict colors explained
verdictColors.intro: Every result uses an icon and a label, never colour alone.

verdictColors.unsafeBody: High risk: the label lists or may contain a food with a severe reaction, one needing treatment, one you are not sure about, or one you avoid strictly.
verdictColors.unknownBody: The label could not be read fully. Check it yourself or scan again.

q1.title: Who are you setting up?
q1.otherHint: A child, partner or anyone you shop for
q1.upsellBody: The Free plan covers you. Plus covers five people and Family fifteen.
q1.noRoom: Your {{plan}} plan has no room for another person.
q1.nameSubtitle: The app uses it in the questions and on their profile.
q1.pickTitle: Who would you like to update?
q1.pickSubtitle: Answering again adds to their profile and never removes anything.

q2.title: Do you have any food allergies or intolerances, or foods you must avoid?
q2.title_other: Does {{name}} have any food allergies or intolerances, or foods they must avoid?
q2.unsureNote: You can pick anything you suspect. It is also worth speaking to a doctor.

q3.title: Which of these do you need to avoid?
q3.title_other: Which of these does {{name}} need to avoid?
q3.subtitle: The 14 allergens labels must highlight come first. Picking is optional; the next question covers anything missing.

q4.title: Is there anything else you need to avoid that isn't in the list?
q4.title_other: Is there anything else {{name}} needs to avoid that isn't in the list?
q4.subtitle: Optional. Type each food on its own, for example "kiwi" or "plantain".
q4.known: We already know this food: recorded as {{name}}, which also catches its other names.
q4.byName: Checked by name only. It may be missed under a different name.
q4.refused: "{{text}}" is on almost every label. Please type the food itself.
q4.full: You can add up to {{count}} foods.

q5.title: What happens when you eat {{food}}?
q5.allergyHint: Hives, itching, swelling, vomiting or trouble breathing, usually within minutes to two hours
q5.intoleranceHint: Bloating, cramps or diarrhoea, often hours later
q5.sensitivity: Something else, or hard to pin down
q5.choice: No reaction; avoided for another reason
q5.unsureHint: We'll treat it as an allergy until you tell us more
q5.unsureNote: Recorded as an allergy, the cautious choice, until you tell us more.

q6.title: How bad has your worst reaction to {{food}} been?
q6.title_other: How bad has {{name}}'s worst reaction to {{food}} been?
q6.severeHint: Trouble breathing, throat or tongue swelling, fainting, or needed an EpiPen or emergency care
q6.treatmentHint: Medicine or a doctor, but not an emergency
q6.mildHint: Uncomfortable, but it passed on its own
q6.unsure: I'm not sure, or it hasn't happened yet
q6.unsureHint: We'll treat it as severe until you tell us otherwise
q6.unsureNote: Treated as severe: products containing it will be shown as High risk. You can change this later.
q6.highNote: Products containing it will be shown as High risk.
q6.warningNote: Products containing it will be shown as a Warning.

q7.title: How strictly do you avoid {{food}}?
q7.strictHint: Any amount is a problem. Shown as High risk.
q7.prefersHint: A small amount is acceptable. Shown as a Warning.

q8.title: Has a doctor confirmed that you react to {{food}}?
q8.title_other: Has a doctor confirmed that {{name}} reacts to {{food}}?
q8.subtitle: Optional. Saved for reference only; it does not change any warning.

q9.title: Do you have a health condition that affects what you eat?
q9.title_other: Does {{name}} have a health condition that affects what they eat?
q9.subtitle: The app then points out ingredients to limit or avoid when products are scanned.

q10.title: Which of these apply to you?
q10.subtitle: Select all that apply.

q11.title: When is your {{condition}} expected to end?
q11.subtitle: Optional.
q11.subtitlePregnancy: Optional. The due date is fine.
q11.note: Two weeks after this date we will ask whether it still applies. The advice never switches off by itself.

q12.title: Anything else you'd like to keep with your profile?
q12.title_other: Anything else you'd like to keep with {{name}}'s profile?
q12.subtitle: Optional. A short note, for example "carries an EpiPen" or "school packed lunch".
q12.privacy: Only you can see this note. Scans never read it.

conditionsScreen.stillAppliesBody: It was expected to end on {{date}}. We keep the advice on until you tell us.
